Addresses #ISSUE [Optional]

### Instructions to reviewer on how to test:
1. Do setup
2. Observe new functionality
3. Ensure tests cover new functionality

### Checks for reviewer
- [ ] Would the PR title make sense to a user on a set of release notes and begin with `feat:`?
- [ ] If the change include breaking changes (to database or api) does the title begin `feat!:`?
- [ ] Are the commits reasonably atomic to re-create the change?
- [ ] Does the title cover all changes made in this PR? (Contain all changes AND only the changes)
